comment: Every agent module ships its definition as agent/<name>.yaml. native-image resolves the
ServiceLoader classes by itself, but not the resources those classes read, so without this
an agent is discovered and then fails to construct: 'No agent definition at /agent/x.yaml'.
Declared once here rather than once per agent. Resource registration is a pattern over the
whole classpath, so this glob covers every agent module that will ever exist and keeps
onboarding one to the files listed in agents/README.md.
